{{Otheruses|Holden}}
'''Holden''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Holden commented on the [[black-powder pistol]] entry, noted that the archaic nature of the weapon meant it was less likely to show up on [[weapon detector]] scans.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
